prompts.prompt: Tell me about a memorable trip or vacation you took. Where did you go, and what did you do?
Describe the house you grew up in. What did the rooms look like, and what is your favorite memory there?
Tell me about your very first job. What were your responsibilities, and what was your boss like?
Describe your favorite holiday or family tradition. How do you usually celebrate it?
Explain, step-by-step, how you make your favorite meal or your morning cup of coffee.
Describe your typical morning routine, from the moment you wake up to when you leave the house.
If you were teaching a beginner how to do your favorite hobby, how would you explain it to them?
Walk me through the steps you take when you are planning a trip or a large family gathering.
If you could travel anywhere in the world tomorrow, where would you go and why?
Tell me about a book, movie, or TV show you really enjoyed recently. What was it about?
Describe your idea of a perfectly relaxing weekend. What would you do from start to finish?
If you could have dinner with any person from history, who would it be and what would you ask them?
